description: Version/capability negotiation with the canonical (empty) v2.0 capability sets, answered OK; the Server then pushes the current ConfigurationPublished, moving the session to READY.
preconditions: Session authenticated (the auth exchange consumed request_id 1, hence Negotiate carries request_id 2).
State machine: NEGOTIATING. Server has a current Transfer Format (48 kHz stereo F32LE, config_generation 1).
v2.0 defines no optional capabilities: both sides send an empty list (spec §4.5).
assertions: protocol_minor = 0 and the empty capabilities list are proto3 defaults and are not encoded on the wire; they are listed in decoded for completeness.

NegotiateResponse echoes the accepted major (2) and the Server's minor within major 2 (0); the capabilities field is the intersection honored for this session — the ONLY session-authoritative set (spec §4.5, adjudication 2026-11-12).
ConfigurationPublished is a push: request_id 0 (proto3 default, not encoded). Server state moves NEGOTIATING -> READY and the push happens in the same transition (spec §5.2).
Note: pairing runs before negotiation; the two capability sets coincide only when both are empty, as here (spec §4.4).
